player_prompt.intro:
Uyindvuna {player_id} eWild Tic Tac Toe.
Ngesikhatsi sekudla, unaweza kukhela 'X' noma 'O' esiteshini esihlulunyweni.
Unawina ukuphinda kwemithambo mitatu iyalingana (X noma O) ngemgomo.
Unawina ngezithombe zonke.
Khetha igamu lakho ngendlela '[X 4]' ukukhela X esikhundleni sentakhi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomati yemigomo ibuhlulu. Sebenzisa '[X 4]' noma '[O 2]' ifomati.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Inombolo yelikheli lengasebenti: {cell}. Kumele ibe semkhatsini wa-0 na-8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Kususa lokungasebenti. Inombolo {cell} seyivele igcwele bantfu.
